messages.label: scam
messages.text: GCash: Your wallet has been flagged for an outdated ID. Outgoing transfers will be disabled tonight at 11:59PM. Update your verification now to avoid restriction: [link]
messages.note: E-wallet sender, account restriction threat with deadline, link to re-verify

messages.label: scam
messages.text: PHLPost: We were unable to deliver your item because the house number is missing. Pay the P35.00 redelivery charge and confirm your address here [link]. Unclaimed items are returned after 48 hrs.
messages.note: Courier name, failed delivery, small fee by link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: MMDA NCAP: Plate no. ending 482 was captured beating the red light on EDSA. Settle the P2,000 penalty within today to prevent registration alarm. Pay via [link]
messages.note: Fake NCAP notice with fine, short deadline and payment link; real NCAP notices have no links

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Congrats! Kasama po kayo sa listahan ng benepisyaryo ng P6,000 Fuel Subsidy ng DSWD. I-claim na via GCash bago mag-expire mamayang gabi: [link]
messages.note: Taglish aid offer from DSWD with e-wallet claim link and same-day deadline

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good day! I'm Hannah from a digital marketing agency. We need people to rate hotels on Google Maps, P120 per review, 30 reviews a day, salary sent daily to your e-wallet. Interested? Add our coordinator on Telegram so she can explain the first task.
messages.note: Unsolicited recruiter, simple paid reviews, move to Telegram: classic task-scam opener

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hello ma'am, this is Mark from the card services team. Someone in Cebu just tried to use your credit card for P45,000. I can cancel it for you now, I've sent a reference code to your mobile, can you read the 6 digits so I can confirm it's really you? Please don't end the call or the block won't go through.
messages.note: Fake bank caller asks to read OTP and keep on line

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Tita si Bea to, bagong sim ko kasi nawala yung phone ko sa jeep. Pwede ba ako makisuyo, kailangan ko magbayad ng tuition ngayon, pa-send ng 5k sa GCash ng roommate ko? Ibabalik ko sa Friday promise. Text lang muna tayo ha, sira mic nito.
messages.note: Hard: relative on new SIM, money to a third person's GCash, avoids calls; no link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello po, napindot ko po yung number nyo sa Maya, P5,000 po napadala ko imbes sa kapatid ko. Pakibalik naman po sa 09XX number na ito, may darating po na code sa inyo, pakisend na lang din po para mabilis ma-refund.
messages.note: Hard: Taglish mistaken-transfer plea with request to forward a code

messages.label: scam
messages.text: BREAKING: Billionaire reveals on live TV the platform making ordinary Filipinos rich. 'Deposit as little as P12,000 and our AI trades for you.' Watch the interview and register before the government shuts it down [link]
messages.note: Fake news-style ad with tycoon endorsement and AI trading

messages.label: scam
messages.text: My love, the box with your necklace and the iPhone finally landed in Manila but Customs is holding it. The officer said you must settle P19,800 for tax before Friday or they will auction it. Please, I can't pay from here, I'll give you back double when I visit in December.
messages.note: Hard: romance partner abroad, gift held by 'Customs', fee before deadline; no link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Good morning, I'm calling from PhilSys. Your National ID record has a mismatch and needs online validation. I'll send you a meeting link, please open it on your phone and tap share screen so I can guide you through the eGov app.
messages.note: Fake PhilSys caller, video meeting, screen sharing

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi! Yes ma'am, May 1-2 is still open for the Batangas beachfront villa, P3,500 only for 20 pax (promo rate). Just send 50% reservation fee to our manager's GCash to lock the date, slots are filling up fast. No refunds for cancellations.
messages.note: Hard: cheap resort promo, deposit to personal e-wallet, scarcity; no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your GCash Authentication code is 482915. Never share this with anyone, even with GCash. Not you? Report it in the app.
messages.note: Genuine-style OTP SMS that warns not to share; no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: J&T Express: Hi Ana, your parcel from ShopEase is out for delivery today. Our rider will call before arriving. Please prepare P0.00 (prepaid order). Track in the J&T app.
messages.note: Real courier notice: no link, no fee, points to the official app

messages.label: safe
messages.text: SSS Reminder: The deadline for March contributions is April 30. Log in to your My.SSS account or the SSS Mobile App to view and pay your PRN. SSS will never ask for your password.
messages.note: Genuine reminder telling you to log in yourself; no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi po, available pa yung rice cooker? Taga Marikina lang ako, pwede ba meet-up sa SM Marikina bukas ng hapon? Cash na lang po bayad ko pag nakita ko na item.
messages.note: Genuine buyer: meet-up, pays cash on seeing the item

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Ma, si Jun to. Na-short ako pambayad sa boarding house, pwede pahiram 2k? Ibabalik ko pag sahod sa 15. Tawagan kita mamaya pag-uwi ko galing shift.
messages.note: Family from usual number, offers to call, no third-party account

messages.label: safe
messages.text: BPI: Your new credit card ending 4417 has been dispatched and will arrive at your billing address in 5-7 banking days. Activate it in the BPI app once received. BPI will never ask for your OTP.
messages.note: Genuine card-dispatch notice: no link, points to the app

messages.label: safe
messages.text: You have received P1,500.00 of GCash from MARIA L. Your new balance is P2,310.45. Ref. No. 2017 0042 on 14 May 2026, 10:22 AM.
messages.note: Genuine 'you received money' notice with no link or request

messages.label: safe
messages.text: BIR reminder: The deadline for filing the Annual Income Tax Return is April 15. File through eBIRForms or eFPS and pay through authorized agent banks or e-payment channels. Visit your Revenue District Office for assistance.
messages.note: Genuine tax reminder: file yourself through official channels, no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Meralco: Your bill for May amounting to P3,245.60 is due on June 10. Pay via the Meralco Mobile App, accredited payment centers or your bank. Disregard if already paid.
messages.note: Genuine utility bill reminder without link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Ate, nakapag-book na ako sa resort sa La Union for Saturday, binayaran ko na thru their website. Sagot ko na, share ka na lang sa gas. Kita tayo sa terminal 5am ha.
messages.note: Friend describing a real booking and payment already done; nothing asked from you
